title: Crown of Chains
setting: Classic fantasy · the kingdom of Valdmark, ruled by the Ever-King Malvoren and his five Magisters
tone: A mix: heroic adventure, spooky secrets and plenty of laughs

quests.title: Tax Day in Ashford
quests.notes: The king's Collectors and a Magister have come to Ashford to count the town. Nobody knows who, or what, they'll take.

hetty-bramblewick.name: Hetty Bramblewick
hetty-bramblewick.notes: Kind and nosy. Secretly an old rebel courier with a smugglers' tunnel in her cellar.

pip-marlow.name: Pip Marlow
pip-marlow.notes: Has a spark of magic: flowers bloom around her when she's nervous.

fen-marlow.name: Old Fen Marlow
fen-marlow.notes: Worried sick that someone will notice Pip's flowers.

brannoc-steel.name: Captain Brannoc Steel
brannoc-steel.notes: Gruff and loyal to the crown, but has a good heart. Has a sick sister.

corvin-krake.name: Magister Corvin Krake, the Collector
corvin-krake.role: one of the king's five Magisters; leads the hunts for the gifted
corvin-krake.notes: Pompous, carries a ledger and counts everything. Arcane chain magic.

pomfrey-trumpington.name: Pomfrey Trumpington
pomfrey-trumpington.role: royal herald travelling with the Collectors
pomfrey-trumpington.notes: SHOUTS every announcement. Accidentally reveals secrets.
